notes.shared_text: Historical preparation report from the first October 9, 2026 Pacific WebRTC trial, imported October 11 without private evidence or new execution: session creation returned 201 but Responses delegation with gpt-6-luna, default reasoning and max_output_tokens 256 reported incomplete with invalid_request_error; the cause was unconfirmed, and the later October 9 note records the subsequent configuration trial.

User-supplied documentation archived on 2026-10-09 Pacific: .sannr/stacks/openai/docs/live/README.md indexes the full create-session.md, primary-websocket.md, sideband-websocket.md, and fork-websocket.md references, with source provenance in manifest.json; this archive does not establish new runtime behavior.

Written down from user-supplied Live documentation archived 2026-10-09 Pacific, not observed: after submitting a Responses tool result with response.item.create, request continuation with response.create or the delegation can remain waiting (.sannr/stacks/openai/docs/live/primary-websocket.md, response.item.create and response.create).

Written down from user-supplied Live documentation archived 2026-10-09 Pacific, not observed: session.commentary.appended acknowledges accepted context without guaranteeing exact wording or completed playback, so do not mark an announcement delivered from that acknowledgment alone (.sannr/stacks/openai/docs/live/primary-websocket.md, session.commentary.appended).

Written down from user-supplied Live documentation archived 2026-10-09 Pacific, not observed: the final snapshot still has status active, so confirm finalization from session.closed rather than the snapshot status or a disconnected socket (.sannr/stacks/openai/docs/live/primary-websocket.md, session.closed).

Written down from user-supplied Live documentation archived 2026-10-09 Pacific, not observed: sideband attachment does not replay earlier events, so missing errors or delegation events in a late capture cannot prove they never occurred; attach early and retain application history when those events matter (.sannr/stacks/openai/docs/live/sideband-websocket.md, Connection).

Written down from user-supplied Live documentation archived 2026-10-09 Pacific, not observed: session.input_audio.muted stops model input while sideband audio reflection continues, so a microphone-off control must separately stop capture or media transmission (.sannr/stacks/openai/docs/live/sideband-websocket.md, session.input_audio.muted).

Historical preparation report from later October 9, 2026 Pacific WebRTC trials, imported October 11 without private evidence or new execution: creation requests with gpt-6-luna, reasoning.effort none and max_output_tokens 512 returned 201, but the retained late sideband captures did not establish a completed delegated reply or confirm the earlier failure cause.
